confidence.definition: A value the producing software reports for how likely an identification, or the signal quantified for it, is correct.

values.pep: Posterior error probability: the probability that this single identification is wrong.
values.q_value: The smallest false discovery rate at which this identification, or quantified signal, is accepted.
values.score: A software-specific score, including classifier probabilities, not calibrated as an error probability or false discovery rate.

entity.definition: The identified entity the value belongs to.

values.precursor: One peptidoform at one charge state.
values.peptidoform: One modified peptide sequence, across charge states.

statistic.definition: How the stored value relates to the underlying per-entity estimates.

values.mean: The mean of estimates over the runs or channels the software combines.
values.percentile: A software-defined percentile of those estimates.

values.identification: Whether the entity is correctly identified.
values.quantification: Whether the signal quantified for an identified entity, such as its MS1 peak, belongs to it.
